title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 privilege escalation to system administrator was possible after…
description: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7. The issue allows users with certain privileges to escalate to system administrator after disabling per-project permissions. This vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.6, indicating a medium severity level.
